edit.description: skill (and command) default contract: whole-grain listing budget advisory
the predicate, if extent cannot carry it
the predicate and its row lift, if new
regenerated binding, if the row moves
binding bless, if the row moves

summary: The shipped skill contract judges the harness's model-invocable skill listing (each entry capped at 1,536 characters) against the runtime's listing budget, advisory and cited
acceptance: a harness whose model-invocable descriptions overrun the cited budget draws one whole-grain advisory; skills with disable-model-invocation are not counted; cargo test green
tests: a skill listing over the listing budget draws one listing budget advisory
a skill that disables model invocation is not counted against the listing budget
a description past the per entry cap counts only its first 1536 characters
notes: skills docs (retrieved 2026-11-26, via summary; re-verify): 1% of the window, entry cut at 1,536 chars of description+when_to_use, least-used dropped first; overrides skillListingBudgetFraction, SLASH_COMMAND_TOOL_CHAR_BUDGET. If the docs give no character figure to judge, leave the entry with a question.
